newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 5.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 5.

text.p: -- Eli Lilly and Co might have to write off a large part of its $4.1 billion acquisition of PCS Health Systems Inc, which has not helped Lilly's bottom line, the Wall Street Journal said. Lilly's shares closed up 7/8 at 93-1/8.

-- Chrysler Corp is expected to announce that suppliers have come up with cost-saving measures that would increase 1997 profits by $325 million, the Wall Street Journal said. Chrysler's stock closed up 1/8 at 32-3/8.

-- Hilton Hotels Corp Chief Financial Officer Matthew Hart said Hilton might walk away from its $6.5 billion hostile takeover bid for ITT Corp if ITT sells its core hotels and gaming properties. Hilton stock closed up 1/2 at 29 while ITT closed down 3/8 at 59-1/4.

-- Telecommunications company Intermedia Communications Inc said it was in a definitive pact to buy DIGEX Inc for $13 per share, or about $150 million. Intermedia shares closed off 1-1/2 at 27-1/8 while DIGEX shares closed down 1/4 at 10-7/8.
